subject: [hw] DONE V40 rev 4: GET_LOG now blocks (vpud log loop: 1 call/5 s, was 805506) + F14 by subtraction
body:
DONE V40 rev 4. Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published, nothing committed by me.

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/run_tests.sh
    == V40 build/run: asan   SUMMARY 459 459
    == V40 build/run: o2     SUMMARY 459 459
    == V40 build/run: tsan   SUMMARY 459 459
    N2TEST V40 PASS 1377/1377
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/compile_ios.sh
    N2TEST V40-IOS PASS 1/1 (arm64-apple-ios16.5, compile only)

Both items of the leads V40 review are fixed; no ABI/request-number change.

1) HIGH: VCU_GET_LOG_OBJECT now blocks like the kernel (mtk_vcu.c:521-545 vcu_log_get: wait_event_freezable(vdec_log_get_wq, vdec_log_got) -> copy -> vdec_log_got = 0).
 - new API in vcu/n2vcu.h: int n2vcu_ap_set_log(struct n2vcu *, const char *text) - mirrors vcu_set_log()/mtk_vcu_write (:2113-2145): strnlen(text,1023)+NUL (:2123), sets vdec_log_got, wakes the waiter. Pending log is returned without waiting.
 - wakes with -EINTR on: a device close (any fd), n2vcu_destroy(), n2vcu_abort(), or the calling cpus stop_request (100 ms pthread_cond_timedwait poll). n2vcu_destroy() sets a destroying flag, broadcasts and waits (500 ms bound) for the blocked call to leave before freeing the context.
 - log_got is cleared after the guest copy (:542). VCU_SET_LOG_OBJECT (model-only request; the kernel has no case) stores the bytes, raises the same flag and wakes a waiter.
 - new stats field log_blocked = calls currently inside the wait (gauge), plus cumulative log_waits.
 - measured on the real vpud host path (IVs runner, this tree): bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh --seconds 5 -> N2VHOST vcu ... log_gets=0 (IVs pre-fix run: 805506). With a gdb breakpoint on vcu_get_log_object the same 5 s run hits it exactly ONCE and never again: the daemons log thread enters the ioctl once and stays blocked instead of spinning. The run still reaches M-c and stops at the unchanged M-d blocker (n2ap_venc_open -EIO, vcu_inst_addr outside the DMEM).
 - tests: t_log_block() keeps a second thread inside the ioctl for 300 ms, releases it with n2vcu_ap_set_log("second-log"), checks the text and <=200 ms latency, proves the flag was cleared (a second GET blocks), and gets -EINTR within 200 ms from stop_request, close and abort; t_log_destroy() proves destroy wakes the waiter before freeing. TSan clean.

2) R1 F14 (low), now done by subtraction as requested: every MAP_SHMEM_*/VCU window range test is vcu_span_contains(base, window, offset, len) = (offset >= base) && offset-base <= window && len <= window-(offset-base). offset+len is never formed, so a 64-bit mmap offset near UINT64_MAX cannot wrap; the rev-3 magic cap is gone. The 32-bit iova guard stays (truncating a 64-bit iova would alias another buffer). Tests: 0xfffffffffffff000 and UINT64_MAX -> 0/EINVAL; last page of ALLOC/COMMIT/PA/MM accepted; one byte less headroom and one byte past each end rejected.

Not done (full list in gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/STATUS.md): GCE lists still execute synchronously; registers inside a VCU window but outside every RWVC_WIN_* window skipped+counted; mem_obj iova=pa=hardware address; SET_MMAP_TYPE returns 0 (kernel -1); log ioctls clamp to the _IOC size and GET_LOG can return -EINTR from close/destroy/abort (a real fd cannot); mmap DMEM honours the offset; bare pa/iova accepted; no unregister; CMD_SEC_WRITE skipped; guest pointer faults are guest faults; destroy waits at most 500 ms for a stuck GET_LOG. Open: CMDQ POLL value/mask semantics; n2vc_dma_guest_map has no pa; the vendor two computed mmap offsets (D01 8.6).

Files: gpu/hwcodec/vcu/{n2vcu.c,n2vcu.h}, gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/{t_v40.c,STATUS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V40/STATUS.md. mtk_vcu_abi.h unchanged. I stay available for review findings.
